sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a pop of color to your wrist with this stunning green enamel kada. Crafted with a premium anti-tarnish gold finish, it offers long-lasting shine and durability. Perfect for daily wear or special occasions, this versatile bangle seamlessly blends traditional charm with contemporary style.
